name: protect-test-integrity
description: Blocks weakening tests to turn them green: a deleted test file (commit only), a net loss of assertions, or an added vacuous assertion (assert True, expect(true).toBe(true)). Added skips are block-test-skips. Runs: commit (incl. an agent's commit: CHOCK_AGENT_COMMIT, CLAUDECODE=1, AI_AGENT or agent_commit_env), agent write (vs disk), turn's end (vs HEAD). Waiver: 'chock: allow test-integrity' on an added line. Person's commit: honoured. Agent: only if already in HEAD; it asks a person. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo. In Cursor the turn's end is not held: a refusal there is handed back to the agent as a follow-up message, once, and a hook that fails to answer lets the turn end.]
